channel.title: Tiny League — changelog
channel.description: New models, benchmarks and updates: benchmark scores for recent small open-weight models.

item.title: Added GigaChat4-37B-A4B (37B MoE, hybrid attention); moved to tinyleague.org; added Discord and GitHub buttons.
item.description: Added GigaChat4-37B-A4B (37B MoE, hybrid attention); moved to tinyleague.org; added Discord and GitHub buttons.

item.title: Added Maxwell-V1-Flash (35B MoE, block-sparse) and Raon-1-mini (29B MoE, Korean).
item.description: Added Maxwell-V1-Flash (35B MoE, block-sparse) and Raon-1-mini (29B MoE, Korean).

item.title: Added Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1.1 (75B sparse-attention MoE) and Ling-3.2-air (124B MoE, vision).
item.description: Added Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1.1 (75B sparse-attention MoE) and Ling-3.2-air (124B MoE, vision).

item.title: Added gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (25B MoE, vision); theme toggle with live system detection.
item.description: Added gemma-4-26B-A4B-it (25B MoE, vision); theme toggle with live system detection.

item.title: Added Inkling-2-Mini; loop-aware KV cache; newest-first heatmap; Core pins DeepSWE 1.1, AutomationBench.
item.description: Added Inkling-2-Mini; loop-aware KV cache; newest-first heatmap; Core pins DeepSWE 1.1, AutomationBench.

item.title: Added OVHaiLLM/Olala-v1.0-mini-7A1B; dropped North-Mini-Code and diffusiongemma.
item.description: Added OVHaiLLM/Olala-v1.0-mini-7A1B; dropped North-Mini-Code and diffusiongemma.

item.title: Added tencent/Hy4-flash, a 220B MoE multimodal model with 12B active parameters.
item.description: Added tencent/Hy4-flash, a 220B MoE multimodal model with 12B active parameters.

item.title: Added SenseNova/SenseNova-Loop-9B, a 9.4B looped-transformer multimodal model.
item.description: Added SenseNova/SenseNova-Loop-9B, a 9.4B looped-transformer multimodal model.

item.title: Mobile layout: compact model cards, section menu, heatmap swipe hint, readable scatter labels.
item.description: Mobile layout: compact model cards, section menu, heatmap swipe hint, readable scatter labels.

item.title: Added Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B; estimated decode speed, a Speed preset and sticky Models headers.
item.description: Added Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B; estimated decode speed, a Speed preset and sticky Models headers.

item.title: v2 redesign: core heatmap, shareable filters, KV-cache column, HLE/IFBench scatter presets; added Spark-X2.6-1.7B, dropped KAT-Coder.
item.description: v2 redesign: core heatmap, shareable filters, KV-cache column, HLE/IFBench scatter presets; added Spark-X2.6-1.7B, dropped KAT-Coder.

item.title: Added LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B; lowered the param floor to 1.5B.
item.description: Added LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B; lowered the param floor to 1.5B.

item.title: Added Sage-A1.5, GPQA/Terminal-Bench scatter charts, and τ²/τ³-bench scores.
item.description: Added Sage-A1.5, GPQA/Terminal-Bench scatter charts, and τ²/τ³-bench scores.

item.title: Added XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B (4.1B dense) and dropped the superseded Spark-X2.5-4B. Added ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-122B (125B MoE, 8B active, vision) and LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B (24B MoE, 2B active). Removed the two oldest entries, Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning and tencent/Hy-MT2-30B-A3B. The coverage heatmap now hides benchmark columns with fewer than two entries as soon as a filter is applied.
item.description: Added XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B (4.1B dense) and dropped the superseded Spark-X2.5-4B. Added ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-122B (125B MoE, 8B active, vision) and LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B (24B MoE, 2B active). Removed the two oldest entries, Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning and tencent/Hy-MT2-30B-A3B. The coverage heatmap now hides benchmark columns with fewer than two entries as soon as a filter is applied.

item.title: Added nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16 and nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-BF16. Re-based the AA Intelligence Index on v4.3.2 and re-fetched every model.
item.description: Added nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-BF16 and nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-BF16. Re-based the AA Intelligence Index on v4.3.2 and re-fetched every model.

item.title: Added openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B (35.2B MoE, vision) — first open-source on-device MoE VLM. Scores from the model card's eval figures (instruct, 4x visual-token compression).
item.description: Added openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B (35.2B MoE, vision) — first open-source on-device MoE VLM. Scores from the model card's eval figures (instruct, 4x visual-token compression).

item.title: Added IFM/K2-Horizon-3.7B. All K2 Horizon models are now on Artificial Analysis: added the AA Intelligence Index (v4.3) to K2-Horizon-3.7B (16), K2-Horizon-7B (21) and K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B (26).
item.description: Added IFM/K2-Horizon-3.7B. All K2 Horizon models are now on Artificial Analysis: added the AA Intelligence Index (v4.3) to K2-Horizon-3.7B (16), K2-Horizon-7B (21) and K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B (26).

item.title: Fixed duplicate benchmark scores (highest shown, conflicts logged), AA fetcher matching, and vision/param detection for new models.
item.description: Fixed duplicate benchmark scores (highest shown, conflicts logged), AA fetcher matching, and vision/param detection for new models.

item.title: Added Agnes-AI/Agnes-3.0-Flash (33.1B dense, vision). Added a License column to the Models table.
item.description: Added Agnes-AI/Agnes-3.0-Flash (33.1B dense, vision). Added a License column to the Models table.

item.title: Added inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL (124.8B MoE, vision) and meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B (29.8B dense, vision).
item.description: Added inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL (124.8B MoE, vision) and meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B (29.8B dense, vision).

item.title: Added nex-agi/Nex-N2.5-mini (35.1B MoE, vision). Added a model filter. Fixed the mobile layout (tables now scroll horizontally, heatmap keeps the model column pinned).
item.description: Added nex-agi/Nex-N2.5-mini (35.1B MoE, vision). Added a model filter. Fixed the mobile layout (tables now scroll horizontally, heatmap keeps the model column pinned).

item.description: Removed the Fara family (and JetBrains/Mellum2-12B); benchmark columns now show specific versions, grouped by family.

item.description: Added openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B (2.5B dense), IFM K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B (36B MoE, 4B active) and K2-Horizon-7B (9B dense).
